name: Juukan ACE NO.07-3
source:
Hayate with the help of the priest girl Tsubaki learns about the location of his lover and silver stone from a fortune-teller. The destination lies across the sea, and heroes don't have money, but captain agrees to give a ride for a night with the helper Konatsu.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在女祭司Tsubaki的帮助下，Hayate从占卜师那里得知了恋人和银色石头的下落。目的地远在海的另一边，一行人却身无分文。不过，船长答应让他们搭船，条件是让同行的助手Konatsu陪他一夜。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
